Name: JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#F4A6C0]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#F7D794]Required for every JerryBB Fashion Sense outfit[/color][/size][/center]

[size=3]A small helper mod for JerryBB's hi-res [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] outfits.
Install it once. Every JerryBB outfit uses this same framework, so you never need a second copy.[/size]

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#FF7FA8]What it does[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#F7D794]Riding[/color] - Hi-res outfits drift off the body when you ride a horse, tractor or broom. The framework keeps them attached.
[*][color=#F7D794]Sitting[/color] - No more floating clothes on chairs and benches.
[*][color=#F7D794]Map icon[/color] - The hair stays on the map and minimap head icon. Without it, hi-res hair looks bald there.
[*][color=#F7D794]Safe[/color] - It works only for JerryBB's Fashion Sense packs. Other creators' outfits are untouched.
[*][color=#F7D794]Settings[/color] - Adjust it in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] 7.0.0 or newer
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the file.
[*]Unzip it into your Mods folder.
[*]Install any JerryBB outfit. They all need this framework.
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#C9B6F2]Files[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]One file for every language. The settings menu follows your game language (English or Korean).
[/list]
[line]
[size=3][b][color=#FF7FA8]Permissions[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported.[/color]

[line]
[size=4][b][color=#F4A6C0]Thank you[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#F7D794]Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:[/color]
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley.
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*][b]PeacefulEnd[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. This framework could not exist without it.
[*][b]spacechase0[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*][b]Bouhm[/b] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url], which helped me test the minimap head icon.
[/list][center][color=#F4A6C0]Thank you for downloading! - JerryBB[/color][/center]

Downloads.Description: Install once. Required for every JerryBB outfit. One file for all languages: the settings follow your game language (English/Korean).

Manifest.Name: JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework
